nodes.text: Sit if you're sitting, buy if you're buying. The fire doesn't care and neither do I — much.
Take your time. The shelf is honest even if the prices sting — *everything a road asks of you*, and a brass key for the chests that ask harder.
Past the lamplight? Camps with teeth, stones with names, and doors _the land itself forgot it was keeping shut_. The further the road runs, the better it pays — and the fewer walk back to spend it.
You'll smell a camp before you see it — stumps, worn ruts, watchers on the rises. Read the ground and it will tell you what's waiting. Ignore it and, well. The Watch digs shallow graves this far out.
